## v1.1.0

- Fix: quick tiles appearance.
- Fix: dialog position in Friend Tracker sort dialog.
- New: about section added.
- Improvement: optimizations throughout the app.

## 1.0.0
  - New: Aurora redesign with a more beautiful, subtle, and fluid UI plus new animations.
  - New: PurrAura solution for ban/login issues on newer Snapchat versions, with no feature tradeoffs.
  - New: Auto Patcher for non-root users; no Shizuku or LSPatch required.

  - New: Scheduled Snaps to send at a specific time.

  - New: message logger whitelist/blacklist mode.

  - New: network status spoofing to Wi‑Fi always.
  - New: "I Can See You" Friend Tracker rule with exact time and duration tracking.
  - New: haptic feedback across the app.
  - New: in-app updater with direct downloads.
  - New: automatic update available notifier.
  - New: customize bottom bar (reorder, remove, set default tab).
  - New: config export/import summary screen.
  - New: search history for quick access to previous features.
  - Improvement: multiple bug fixes and overall polish for a premium feel.

changelog.name: V1.0.0-BETA
changelog.body:
**THIS IS A BETA BUILD! BUGS ENCOUNTERED SHOULD BE REPORTED IN THE TELEGRAM GROUP!**

**Changelogs(Rass Malayi Build):**

Introducing Aurora, our new, complete redesign of the PurrfectSnap app.. The app now looks more beautiful, more visually appealing, more subtle and more fluid with cool new animations. Everything has now been completely redesigned to give you a refreshing experience.
Introducing PurrAura, our new solution to the ban+login issues of newer versions of Snapchat. This solution also has no disadvantages so now you can add/block/remove friends, add music to snaps, etc easily!
Introducing Auto Patcher, our new feature meant to simplify the process of installation for non-root users by 90% !! Now, you don't need to install Shizuku and Lspatch for patching & installation!
Introducing Auto Reply, our new feature meant to completely overhaul your Snapchat experience! Now you can configure AI to automatically respond to chats, stories, half swipes, etc! Super useful for content creators! (Requires a Valid API key, you can grab a free one from Google AI Studio)
Introducing Scheduled Snaps, our new feature meant to automate your snaps. You can now set when do you want to send a snap rather than sending it instantly. For example: If you want to send a snap to your friend at midnight to wish him Happy Birthday but you won't be available at that time for some reason, no problem! Now you cam simply set the time when you want to send and boom! PurrfectSnap will handle it for you!
Introducing Auto Delete Sent Messages! Now you can set a custom time after which you want your message to be deleted!
Introducing Message Translator! Now, you can automatically set to translate incoming messages to your preferred language!
Introducing Hide Typing Indicators Whitelist/Blacklist mode! Now you can select which friends you want to hide typing indicators from instead of the previous behavior that hid it completely.
Introducing Message Logger Whitelist/Blacklist mode! Now you can select which friends you want to use Message Logger on instead of the previous behavior that logged everyone.
You can know spoof Device Model to a high-end device which might help in performance, camera processing and several other improvements.
You can know spoof your network status to Wi-Fi always to prevent several restrictions on mobile data.
A new "I Can See You" Friend Tracker rule has been added! This allows you to track the exact time & duration when a friend enters your chat.
Introducing Haptic Feedback! Now you can feel every click of the button!
Introducing In-App Updater so no need to go around looking for GitHub/Nightly links! Direct update through the app!
Introducing Automatic Update Available Notifier! So now, you can always get the latest PurrfectSnap updates on time!
Introducing Customize Bottom Bar Feature! Now you can customize the bottom bar of PurrfectSnap to your needs! For example: If you want to release the Tasks tab with Friend Tracker tab, now you can do it.. You can also remove unwanted tabs or set a default tab that should open first.
Introducing Config Export/Import summary screen! Now you can directly see which features that config will enable once you import/export it so you can know before importing/exporting.
Introducing Search History in PurrfectSnap! Now you can easily access your previously searched features in PurrfectSnap!
Multiple other bug fixes were made and the app is now polished and you will be able to notice a premium feel upon first use...

We thank RSR, our best dev, who has made many of these features possible! We also thank all of the admins and testers for their continuous support during this time.

# PurrfectSnap ### An Xposed module meant to redefine your Snapchat experience! Works on both non-rooted and rooted devices!
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/particle-box/PurrfectSnap?include_prereleases&style=for-the-badge&color=cba6f7&labelColor=1e1e2e)](https://github.com/particle-box/PurrfectSnap/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/particle-box/PurrfectSnap/total?style=for-the-badge&color=f5bde6&labelColor=1e1e2e)](https://github.com/particle-box/PurrfectSnap/releases) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-GPL_3.0-f5a97f?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=1e1e2e)](https://github.com/particle-box/PurrfectSnap/blob/dev/LICENSE) [Installation](#installation) • [Features](#features) • [Changelog](#whats-new) • [Community](#community)

--- ## Overview PurrfectSnap is built on the foundation of SnapEnhance, pushing boundaries with innovative features and a refined user experience. This isn't just another fork; it's a complete reimagining of what's possible. We're committed to active development, bringing you powerful tools that actually matter. Every feature is designed with real users in mind, not just for the sake of adding to a feature list.
## Philosophy This project exists because we believe in continuous innovation. We're grateful to the original SnapEnhance team for their groundbreaking work, and we're building on that legacy by exploring new possibilities and listening to what the community actually wants. No aggressive donation requests. No minimal changes disguised as “major updates.” Just genuine development driven by a passion for creating something exceptional.
---
## Features PurrfectSnap offers deep control across media, privacy, automation, and UI—designed for both casual users and power users.
### Media Downloader Advanced media management with extensive customization options for downloading and organizing content. **Core Capabilities** - Custom save locations and path formatting - Automatic downloads from selected sources - Profile picture downloads - Voice note capture with format control - FFmpeg integration for advanced processing **Smart Features** - Duplicate prevention with override option - Overlay merging for combined content - Custom logging for tracking downloads - Context menu integration ### User Interface Complete control over your interface with deep customization options. **Visual Customization** - Custom themes including AMOLED mode - Configurable icon styles - Message preview customization - Bootstrap override for default tabs **Interface Control** - Hide unwanted UI components - Enhanced friend map nametags - Snap preview options - Streak expiration info display - Vertical story viewer - Message indicators and stealth mode display
### Messaging Privacy-focused messaging features with advanced control over your conversations. **Privacy Tools** - Screenshot bypass - Anonymous story viewing - Hide typing notifications - Hide Bitmoji presence - Prevent story rewatch indicators **Enhanced Features** - Unlimited snap view time - Auto mark as read - Conversation pinning (unlimited) - Message logger with whitelist/blacklist - Better notifications with blacklist support - Double tap actions and reactions - Message retention policy bypass ### Global Settings System-wide enhancements that improve your overall experience. **Performance** - Better location handling - Media upload quality control - Custom video playback rates - Default volume controls **Optimization** - Ad blocking - Metrics disabling - Story section control - Video length restriction bypass - Snap splitting disable - Telecom framework control
### Camera Professional-grade camera controls for content creation. **Recording Options** - Custom frame rates (front/back) - HEVC recording support - Custom resolution override - Force camera source encoding **Creative Control** - Immersive preview mode - Black photo option - Startup default camera selection ### Rules Engine Automation system for complex workflows. - Stealth mode rules - Auto download conditions - Auto save parameters - Auto open snap rules - Unsaveable message settings
### Experimental Cutting-edge features for power users. **Advanced Tools** - Native hooks for deep customization - Spoofing capabilities - Story logger - Call recorder - Account switcher - App lock - End-to-end encryption - My Eyes Only passcode bypass **Developer Features** - Better transcript - Friend notes - COF experiments - Custom streaks format - Prevent forced logout ### Scripting Extensibility through custom scripts. - Developer mode - Module folder management - Auto reload capability - Integrated UI - Log control options - Optimization toggles

**Additional Features** > **Streaks Reminder** — Configurable interval notifications with remaining time display and group notification support > **Friend Tracker** — Event recording with background operation and automatic purge management
---
## What's New Here's what makes PurrfectSnap different from upstream SnapEnhance.
### Aurora Design System A complete visual language rebuilt from the ground up. Not just a theme, an entire design philosophy. The interface now flows with purpose. Subtle animations guide your interactions. Every screen has been reconsidered, every transition refined. The result is an experience that feels premium without being ostentatious.
### PurrAura The ban problem? Solved. No more sacrificing features to stay safe. Add friends, block users, attach music; everything works as it should. No workarounds, no compromises, no disadvantages.
### Auto Patcher Installation was complicated. Now it isn’t. We've eliminated 90% of the installation friction. No Shizuku. No LSPatch. Just a straightforward process that respects your time.
### Intelligence Layer **Auto Reply** Let AI handle routine responses while you focus on what matters. Configure automatic replies for chats, stories, and half-swipes. Essential for creators managing volume. Requires an API key from Google AI Studio, they offer free tier access. **Scheduled Snaps** Time-shifted communication. Set a snap to send at midnight for a birthday. Queue content for optimal timing:your schedule, automated. **Message Translator** Language barriers, eliminated. Incoming messages automatically translate to your preferred language. Set it once, communicate globally.
### Privacy Enhancements **Granular Controls** Whitelist and blacklist modes for typing indicators and message logging. Choose exactly who sees what, friend by friend. **Auto Delete Messages** Set expiration times for your messages. They disappear on your schedule, not Snapchat's. **Message Logger Viewer** Review exported logs directly in-app. No external tools required.
### Data Persistence **Friend Notes Backup** Your notes are valuable. Now they're protected. Export and restore with ease. Never lose context again.
### Device Management **ID Spoofing** Device bans happen. Sometimes unjustly. We offer a solution for legitimate cases, approval required with proof of wrongful ban. This feature is restricted to prevent abuse. **Model Spoofing** Identify as a high-end device model. Potential performance improvements, enhanced camera processing, and better feature access. **Network Spoofing** Spoof your network status to Wi-Fi always to prevent several restrictions on mobile data.
### Restored Functionality Features that disappeared? They're back. Bulk messaging works again. Friend list management is fully operational. These aren't new features, they're restored capabilities that should never have been lost.
### Discovery **Scripts Catalog** Browse and install scripts without leaving the app. No more hunting for import links. One-tap installation. Always current. **Friend Tracker Catalog** Browse and install tracking rules without leaving the app. One-tap installation. Always current. **Friend Tracker Import/Export** Backup and restore your Friend Tracker configurations with ease.
### Advanced Tracking **I Can See You Rule** Track the exact time and duration when a friend enters your chat. Precision visibility tracking for Friend Tracker. **Auto Open Snaps Enhancement** More granular control with queue size configuration and customizable delays.
### Visual Refinements **AMOLED Theme** True black. Battery-saving. The most requested feature, delivered. **Haptic Feedback** Subtle tactile responses. Every interaction confirmed through touch. **Customizable Bottom Bar** Your navigation, your rules. Rearrange tabs, remove what you don't use, set your default view. Complete flexibility. **Search History** Recently searched features, instantly accessible. No more hunting through menus.
### Infrastructure **In-App Updates** New versions install directly from within the app. No GitHub hunting. No manual downloads. Just seamless updates. **Update Notifications** Stay current automatically. Get notified when new releases are available. **Config Export/Import Summary** See exactly which features a config will enable before importing or exporting. Know what you're getting.
### Quality Hundreds of refinements you'll feel but might not see. Smoother animations. Faster response times. Eliminated edge cases. The kind of polish that separates good from exceptional. > ⚠️Some features are intended for educational, recovery, or accessibility purposes. Misuse may violate Snapchat’s terms of service. > **We are not affiliated with Snap Inc. and are not responsible for any violations by the user. Our sole purpose is for education purposes only!**
---
## Installation The guide is no longer needed! Just download and install PurrfectSnap from [here](https://github.com/particle-box/PurrfectSnap/releases). The app automatically detects your device type and applies the appropriate setup.
---
## Community Questions? Ideas? Found a bug? Our community is active and responsive. **[Telegram Channel](https://t.me/purrfectsnap_official)** : Announcements, discussions, and support **For the discussions group link, refer to the description of the channel!**
---
## Contributing We welcome contributions from developers who share our vision. Whether it's code, documentation, etc., contributions are always appreciated. Feel free to open a PR :)
---
## Credits PurrfectSnap is built with exceptional open source tools. We do not collect any user information. However, please be aware that third-party libraries may collect data as described in their respective privacy policies. **Core Dependencies** - [SnapEnhance](https://github.com/rhunk/SnapEnhance) — The foundation - [libxposed](https://github.com/libxposed/api) — Framework integration - [Jingmatrix Lspatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch) — Auto Patcher - [Dobby](https://github.com/jmpews/Dobby) — Native hooking - [O‑MVLL](https://github.com/open-obfuscator/o-mvll) — Obfuscation - [hiddenapibypass](https://github.com/LSPosed/HiddenApiBypass) — Hidden API access - [dexlib2 (smali)](https://github.com/JesusFreke/smali) — Dex parsing - [Bouncy Castle](https://www.bouncycastle.org/) — Cryptography - [apksig](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/tools/apksig/) — APK signing tools - [Rust Android Gradle Plugin](https://github.com/mozilla/rust-android-gradle) — Native build tooling - [Android Gradle Plugin](https://developer.android.com/build) — Build system - [Kotlin](https://kotlinlang.org/) — Language - [Compose Compiler](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/compose/compiler) — Compose compiler **Media Processing** - [ffmpeg-kit-full-gpl](https://github.com/arthenica/ffmpeg-kit) — Media manipulation - [coil](https://github.com/coil-kt/coil) — Image loading - [smart-exception-java](https://github.com/arthenica/ffmpeg-kit) — ffmpeg-kit support lib **Scripting Engine** - [rhino](https://github.com/mozilla/rhino) — JavaScript runtime - [rhino-android](https://github.com/F43nd1r/rhino-android) — Android integration **Utilities** - [osmdroid](https://github.com/osmdroid/osmdroid) — Map functionality - [libsu](https://github.com/topjohnwu/libsu) — Root operations - [colorpicker-compose](https://github.com/skydoves/colorpicker-compose) — Color selection - [OkHttp](https://github.com/square/okhttp) — Networking - [Gson](https://github.com/google/gson) — JSON parsing - [jsoup](https://github.com/jhy/jsoup) — HTML parsing - [Fetch](https://github.com/tonyofrancis/Fetch) — Download manager - [WorkManager](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/work) — Background tasks - [Accompanist](https://github.com/google/accompanist) — Compose utilities - [Guava](https://github.com/google/guava) — Core utilities - [Kotlin Coroutines](https://github.com/Kotlin/kotlinx.coroutines) — Async - [AndroidX DocumentFile](https://developer.android.com/reference/androidx/documentfile/provider/DocumentFile) — File access - [AndroidX RecyclerView](https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/recyclerview) — Lists - ## 特点 PurrfectSnap 提供跨媒体、隐私、自动化和 UI 的深度控制 - 专为临时用户和高级用户设计。 <表> ### 媒体下载器 高级媒体管理，具有用于下载和组织内容的广泛自定义选项。 **核心能力** - 自定义保存位置和路径格式 - 从选定的来源自动下载 - 个人资料图片下载 - 带有格式控制的语音笔记捕获 - FFmpeg 集成用于高级处理 **智能功能** - 通过覆盖选项防止重复 - 组合内容的叠加合并 - 用于跟踪下载的自定义日志记录 - 上下文菜单集成 ### 用户界面 通过深度定制选项完全控制您的界面。 **视觉定制** - 自定义主题，包括 AMOLED 模式 - 可配置的图标样式 - 消息预览自定义 - 默认选项卡的引导程序覆盖 **界面控制** - 隐藏不需要的 UI 组件 - 增强的朋友地图姓名标签 - 快照预览选项 - 连续到期信息显示 - 垂直故事查看器 - 消息指示器和隐身模式显示 ### 消息传递 注重隐私的消息传递功能，可对您的对话进行高级控制。 **隐私工具** - 截图绕过 - 匿名故事观看 - 隐藏打字通知 - 隐藏 Bitmoji 存在 - 防止故事重看指示器 **增强功能** - 无限的快照查看时间 - 自动标记为已读 - 对话固定（无限制） - 带白名单/黑名单的消息记录器 - 更好的通知与黑名单支持 - 双击动作和反应 - 消息保留策略绕过 ### 全局设置 系统范围内的增强功能可改善您的整体体验。 **性能** - 更好的位置处理 - 媒体上传质量控制 - 自定义视频播放速率 - 默认音量控制 **优化** - 广告拦截 - 指标禁用 - 故事部分控制 - 绕过视频长度限制 - 快照分割禁用 - 电信框架控制 ### 相机 用于内容创建的专业级相机控制。 **录音选项** - 自定义帧速率（前/后） - HEVC 录制支持 - 自定义分辨率覆盖 - 强制相机源编码 **创意控制** - 沉浸式预览模式 - 黑色照片选项 - 启动默认相机选择 ### 规则引擎 用于复杂工作流程的自动化系统。 - 隐身模式规则 - 自动下载条件 - 自动保存参数 - 自动打开捕捉规则 - 不可保存的消息设置 ### 实验性的 适合高级用户的尖端功能。 **高级工具** - 用于深度定制的原生钩子 - 欺骗功能 - 故事记录器 - 通话录音 - 帐户切换器 - 应用程序锁 - 端到端加密 - My Eyes Only 密码绕过 **开发者功能** - 更好的成绩单 - 朋友笔记 - COF实验 - 自定义条纹格式 - 防止强制注销 ### 脚本编写 通过自定义脚本进行扩展。 - 开发者模式 - 模块文件夹管理 - 自动重新加载能力 - 集成用户界面 - 日志控制选项 - 优化切换
**附加功能** > **条纹提醒** — 可配置的间隔通知，具有剩余时间显示和组通知支持 > **好友追踪器** — 具有后台操作和自动清除管理的事件记录

## 新消息 PurrfectSnap 与上游 SnapEnhance 的不同之处如下。
### 极光设计系统 从头开始重建完整的视觉语言。不仅仅是一个主题，而是整个设计理念。 界面现在有目的地流动。微妙的动画指导您的互动。每个屏幕都经过重新考虑，每个过渡都经过改进。其结果是一种感觉优质而不招摇的体验。
### 呼噜声 禁令问题？解决了。 不再需要牺牲功能来保证安全。添加好友、屏蔽用户、附加音乐；一切都按其应有的方式进行。没有变通办法，没有妥协，没有缺点。
### 自动修补程序 安装很复杂。现在不是了。 我们已经消除了 90% 的安装摩擦。没有雫。没有 LSP 补丁。只是一个尊重您时间的简单过程。
### 情报层 **自动回复** 让人工智能处理日常响应，而您则专注于重要的事情。配置聊天、故事和半滑动的自动回复。对于管理音量的创作者来说至关重要。需要 Google AI Studio 的 API 密钥，他们提供免费层访问。 **预定的快照** 时移通信。设置在生日午夜发送的快照。将内容排队以获得最佳时间：您的日程安排，自动化。 **消息翻译器** 语言障碍，消除。传入消息会自动翻译为您的首选语言。一次设置，全球通讯。
### 隐私增强 **精细控制** 用于输入指示器和消息记录的白名单和黑名单模式。准确选择谁能看到什么，逐个朋友。 **自动删除消息** 设置消息的过期时间。它们会消失在你的日程安排中，而不是 Snapchat 的日程安排上。 **消息记录器查看器** 直接在应用程序内查看导出的日志。无需外部工具。
### 数据持久化 **好友笔记备份** 你的笔记很有价值。现在他们受到保护。轻松导出和恢复。永远不会再失去上下文。
### 设备管理 **身份欺骗** 设备禁令发生。有时不公正。我们为合法案件提供解决方案，需要批准并提供错误禁令的证明。限制此功能是为了防止滥用。 **模型欺骗** 识别为高端设备型号。潜在的性能改进、增强的相机处理和更好的功能访问。 **网络欺骗** 始终欺骗您的 Wi-Fi 网络状态，以防止对移动数据的多种限制。
### 恢复功能 消失的功能有耳？他们回来了。 群发消息又可以使用了。好友列表管理已全面投入使用。这些不是新功能，而是恢复了不应该丢失的功能。
### 发现 **脚本目录** 无需离开应用程序即可浏览并安装脚本。不再需要寻找导入链接。一键安装。始终是最新的。 **好友追踪器目录** 无需离开应用程序即可浏览并安装跟踪规则。一键安装。始终是最新的。 **好友追踪器导入/导出** 轻松备份和恢复您的好友追踪器配置。
### 高级跟踪 **我可以看到你统治** 跟踪朋友进入您的聊天的确切时间和持续时间。好友追踪器的精确可见度追踪。 **自动打开按扣增强功能** 通过队列大小配置和可定制的延迟进行更精细的控制。
### 视觉优化 **AMOLED主题** 真黑。节省电池。最需要的功能已交付。 **触觉反馈** 微妙的触觉反应。每一次互动都通过触摸来确认。 **可定制的底栏** 你的导航，你的规则。重新排列选项卡，删除不使用的内容，设置默认视图。完全的灵活性。 **搜索历史** 最近搜索的功能，可立即访问。不再需要通过菜单进行搜索。
### 基础设施 **应用内更新** 新版本直接从应用程序内安装。没有 GitHub 搜索。无需手动下载。只是无缝更新。 **更新通知** 自动保持最新状态。当有新版本可用时收到通知。 **配置导出/导入摘要** 在导入或导出之前准确查看配置将启用哪些功能。知道你会得到什么。
### 质量 您会感受到但可能看不到的数百种改进。更流畅的动画。响应时间更快。消除了边缘情况。这种抛光将优秀与卓越区分开来。 > ⚠️某些功能旨在用于教育、恢复或辅助目的。滥用可能会违反 Snapchat 的服务条款。 > **我们不隶属于 Snap Inc.，对用户的任何违规行为不承担任何责任。我们的唯一目的只是为了教育目的！**
